tools.title: Google News Scraper
tools.summary: Search Google News by keyword, topic or publisher and get articles with title, source, date, snippet and the resolved publisher URL — plus optional full article text, author, image and keywords. Any language or country.
tools.description: Supports Google News operators such as "exact phrase", site:reuters.com, when:7d and before:2026-01-01. Up to 100 articles per query. Google's encoded redirect links are resolved to the publisher's real URL.

tools.title: App Store Reviews Scraper
tools.summary: Apple App Store reviews for any iOS app and country storefront: rating, title, text, version, author, date, plus app metadata.

sample_output.title: Confusing
sample_output.content: It's probably because I'm new but it is really confusing to work with.

tools.description: Apple exposes the 500 most recent reviews per app per country (sorted by most recent or most helpful). Run on a schedule and deduplicate by reviewId to build a history.

tools.title: Shopify Products Scraper
tools.summary: Full product catalog of any Shopify store or collection: prices, compare-at prices, variants, SKUs, stock, images, tags and descriptions.
tools.description: Works on any Shopify storefront without login. Pass a store homepage for the whole catalog, a /collections/<handle> URL for one collection, or a /products/<handle> URL for a single product.

tools.title: Hacker News Scraper
tools.summary: Search or browse Hacker News stories, comments, Ask HN, Show HN and Who's Hiring threads via the official Algolia API, with points and date filters.

sample_output.title: Show HN: Apify – Turn any website into an API
sample_output.author: jancurn

tools.description: Uses HN's official Algolia Search API, so results are fast and reliable. Filter by tag (story, comment, ask_hn, show_hn, job), minimum points, and date range. Leave queries empty and sort by date to pull the newest items for a tag, e.g. the latest monthly Who's Hiring thread.

tools.title: Google Play Reviews Scraper
tools.summary: Google Play app reviews and app details by app ID or search term: rating, text, date, replies, plus installs, score and developer info.
tools.description: Pass Google Play package names (appIds, e.g. com.spotify.music) or plain searchTerms to resolve the top matching app automatically. Returns review rows plus an optional app-details row (installs, score, rating histogram, developer). Supports country/language targeting and sort by newest, rating or helpfulness.

tools.title: Substack Scraper
tools.summary: Any Substack publication as structured data: posts with full article text, engagement stats, and comment threads. Custom domains supported.

sample_output.title: God Help Us, Let's Try To Learn About Mechanistic Interpretability Techniques
sample_output.bodyText:
The Story So Far
Mechanistic interpretability is the science of “reading an AI’s mind”…

tools.description: Give it a Substack handle (astralcodexten), a *.substack.com URL or a custom domain (bigtechnology.com) and get every post as a flat record — including the full article text, which the public archive listing does not contain. Optional comment threads come back flattened with parentCommentId so you can rebuild the tree. Filter by keyword (searchQuery), date range, or free vs. paywalled posts. Reads only what a logged-out visitor sees: no login, no paywall bypass, no headless browser.
